provenance.selection: Top 100 distinct MW Ṛgveda verse loci by citation count, range-checked against the committed per-hymn stanza table.

summary.verificationMethod: HTTP HEAD (one-byte ranged GET fallback) per URL + per-verse anchor presence in the fetched GRETIL edition page.

assumptions: Locus = MW's explicit RV maṇḍala, hymn, verse (e.g. 'RV. v, 86, 5' -> 5.86.5); work-level and malformed citations are excluded.
The stable passage URL is GRETIL's Aufrecht RV edition with its per-verse anchor RV_<maṇḍala>.<hymn:3>.<verse:2>.
VedaWeb is carried as a second, independently addressable edition; the verified target is GRETIL.
DCS is link-out only and is NOT the verified target: its search pages sit behind an interactive browser challenge, so a machine HTTP check cannot establish a stable passage URL.
warnings: HTTP 200 + anchor presence proves the edition page and verse anchor exist; it does not prove MW's quotation matches the verse. Human spot-checks remain required.
Only MW RV citations are piloted. Epic/purāṇa sources need per-text GRETIL files or another edition with verse anchors.
